justification: Inspected `javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/EncoderConfig.java` and `javase/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/j2se/CommandLineEncoder.java`. `EncoderConfig` is a 63-line final class with 8 fields annotated for JCommander and no methods; it acts only as a simple CLI parameter holder for `CommandLineEncoder`. The class shows one narrow responsibility and no evidence of separate cohesive subareas, so insufficient modularization is not present.
